resume: Multi-engine synth, successor to Felucca: sixteen engines with factory presets (ANALOG, SEM, HADES, PHASE, LOFI, TRIO, WHEEL, FM6, PHYS, VOICE, SAMPLE, GRAIN, DRUM, NOISE, experimental DRONE), four tracks sharing eight voices, a 64-step sequencer, effects, a modulation matrix and MIDI. Version 0.6.0 adds STASIS, which freezes a reverb texture.

commandes.role: Down one octave. With OCT+ at the same time, returns to octave 0 and releases the notes held by LATCH on the track. On confirmation screens (project compatibility), CANCEL.
Up one octave. Also acts as confirm: starts a STASIS ADD or BLEND, opens a macro's map, loads a project live from SAVE > PROJECT, TEST on the compatibility screen.
Opens the effects family: FX (sends), DLY, REVERB, CHORUS, INSERT, INSERT 2, SLICER. Each screen shows two groups of four settings.
Opens ENV and ENV DEST. Pressed repeatedly, it also goes to the PAIR (Pair Morph) and MACRO pages.
Opens the LFO pages. Pressed repeatedly, it reaches LFO2.
Opens the EDIT pages, from any page. On the STEP screen, with a note key held, clears the step's locks.
Global shortcuts: GLO held + SELECT sets the tempo. GLO held + HOME adds the touched setting to the HOME screen.
Returns to the HOME screen. Held, opens the settings menu (MENU), where SELECT steps through the rows.
Opens saving (SAVE > PROJECT, slots A to D). Held after a load, undoes it.
Opens the sequencer (STEP page with piano roll). SEQ held + F5 clears the step at the cursor. SEQ held + REC arms step recording.
Arms recording (live, or step by step depending on the mode). A normal press disarms it.
Chooses the active row or group. Its role depends on MENU > CONTROL > SELECT (BPM, PAGE, MODW or VEL, PAGE by default). In PAGE, it visits the top group, the bottom group, then the next page.
Opens the preset list for the track's engine. During step recording, chooses the step.
Chooses the track. Held in the menu (with HOME held), leads to VOICES.
Play the track's notes. With LATCH on the CHORD page, the notes keep sounding after release.

gestes: GLO held + HOME: adds the setting you just turned to the HOME screen.
GLO held + SELECT: sets the tempo.
SEQ held + F5: clears the step at the cursor (CLEAR STEP).
SEQ held + REC: arms step recording (STEP REC). Repeating the gesture switches to LIVE REC.
OCT- and OCT+ together: octave 0 and end of the track's LATCH notes.
SAVE held after a load: undoes it.

modes.texte: Set the track's REV send to 85 to 90 percent, open FX > REVERB and choose the STASIS type. Play for about 0.6 seconds with CAPT on LIVE, then choose HOLD: the captured sound keeps going after release. STR sets the amount of texture, MOTN animates it. STOP releases. In FX > LAYER, ADD mode mixes in a new sound (AMT sets its share) and BLEND mode crossfades to a new texture over 1 to 30 seconds. Both are triggered with OCT+.

HOME shows four knobs, with one active row enlarged. GLO + HOME adds a setting to it. HOME held then EDIT CELLS reorders or removes. With ENV on MACRO, turning a macro then pressing OCT+ opens its map: up to four parameters per macro, four macros per track. With ENV on PAIR, two melodic tracks blend together (Pair Morph).

64-step sequencer with chords, ties, probabilities, conditions, ratchets and automation. During playback, SAVE > PROJECT lets you keep parts A to D and launch them live (LOAD then OCT+). Loading happens at the end of track 1's loop.

a_savoir: The 0.6.0 profile contains HALL and STASIS. ROOM, SPRING and the SLICE engine are removed (the SLICER track effect remains). An old project that uses them offers CANCEL / TEST with the substitutions.
The tempo delay is suspended while STASIS is active. The captured audio is in volatile RAM and is not stored in projects.
The DRONE engine is experimental. The SCL and CHORD pages show their keys under the settings group.
The documentation says tests on a real FM-1 are pending, and refers to the Felucca manual for inherited controls.
